name: Skitter Plague

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), chapter 16. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. The onset is the book's 1d4 hours at its average (2); a body bursting into a swarm at midnight and death when the maximum reaches 0 wait on the engine.

summary: A hag's contagion carried by her centipedes: a fever that won't break and blisters that eat at the body a little more with every night's sleep, until three good mornings throw it off.
